bagPolicy.summary: Clear bags up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches and nonclear bags up to 6 × 9 inches are allowed; all are inspected. Hydration backpacks and oversized luggage are prohibited.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Main Field Parking is included with concert admission; follow staff into the onsite field. Accessible spaces are in Lot 3 of Main Field Parking, and Premium Field Parking can be purchased separately.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue has a designated Uber/Lyft drop-off and pickup area and recommends arranging pickup in advance. Accessible passenger drop-off is separately in Main Field Parking by the main pedestrian walkway.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Concession stands take cards and mobile pay only. Outside food and beverages are prohibited except food for medical or dietary needs in a clear one-gallon plastic bag.
allowed: Medical or dietary food in clear one-gallon bag
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible spaces are in each parking area; Lot 3 serves Main Field Parking. Accessible concert seats can be bought through the official ticket map.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: No re-entry after leaving without a new ticket, except when management instructs guests otherwise, such as for a weather evacuation.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Will-call tickets may be collected on show days at the box office with a photo ID matching the buyer’s name. The box office opens one hour before showtime.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Follow on-site signs to the assigned parking area and entry gate. Gate-opening times vary by event, and the venue publishes an entry map in its FAQ.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
